_why: The device gate's checks in 5 groups, each on its own Simulator with its own vault (.github/workflows/device-gate.yml matrix), so a lost tap in one group cannot hide the checks of another, and a whole run takes ~30 min, not ~70 (serial runs 46098006485..46158251765 found one failure per 70-minute run). Every Simulator check is in exactly one group (tests/device-gate-groups.test.ts).
